meta.title: Makeshift Reprise
meta.author: H0ffman
meta.description: The soundtrack of Makeshift Reprise by H0ffman (2019-04-21). 32K executable music that placed 4th in the executable music competition at Revision 2019. 140 BPM, 3:46, 19 tracks, 5187 notes. Instruments: 4 Falcon (FM synth), 9 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 4 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler). Effects: 6 Scissor, 14 Leveller, 4 Crusher, 8 Echo, 10 Smasher, 1 Chamber, 2 Twister, 14 Cathedral. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.06 dB loudness and at most 1.08 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
